firstNightReminder: Point to a player who woke up tonight.
otherNightReminder: Point to a player who woke up tonight.

ability: Each night, learn a player who woke up tonight.

otherNightReminder: If tonight is armageddon night: the Armageddon chooses 3 players. If a good player is not among them, shake your head, and they choose again. :reminder: :reminder: :reminder: The 3 chosen players can't die or change alignment, even from Assassin. name: Armageddon Ω
ability: On your 4th night, choose 3 alive players (not Travellers), including 1 good: only they survive tonight & can no longer change alignment. This must happen. Tomorrow, if nobody dies, your team wins.
flavor: I am become death, destroyer of worlds. -J. Robert Oppenheimer

firstNightReminder: The Arsonist might choose a player. :reminder:
otherNightReminder: The Arsonist might choose a player. :reminder: If the Arsonist chose no one, kill all players that are poisoned, even if not poisoned by the Arsonist. :reminder: Then, players the Arsonist was poisoning become Healthy. :reminder:
name: Arsonist Ω
ability: Each night, you may choose a player: they are poisoned. If you chose no one, all poisoned players die, then all players you poisoned become healthy. This cannot kill night 1.
flavor: Some people just want to watch the world burn.

otherNightReminder: The Warden chooses a player. :reminder: Wake the target, and allow them to communicate. At any point, the Warden may indicate they want the target to die. :reminder: If so, they die right before dawn. :reminder:
name: Warden Ω
ability: Each night*, choose a player: you have a private conversation with them during the night. They might not wake to use their ability tonight. Once per game, you can kill the player you chose.
